methodology.warning_base: WP24181 non-null; all eight channels retained; any code 1 means warned; codes 2/97/98/99 count as not warned.
methodology.action_base: All respondents with at least one warning; WP24215 codes 1/2/98/99 remain in denominator.
methodology.georgia: COUNTRY_ISO3=GEO; impacted and warning-question bases are separate; publisher country-ranking threshold is n>=100.

limitations: Independent arithmetic on the publisher's pinned public survey microdata is not an independent survey or operational early-warning audit.
Survey warning receipt and self-reported ability to act do not establish message timeliness, comprehension, verified protective action or avoided loss.
Georgia's warning-question base is below the publisher's n>=100 country-ranking threshold; no national effectiveness ranking is inferred.
